A few things you might be wondering

Before you
tune in.

01When and where is the next event?

The Noise Paradox is the next chapter of TEDxNITKSurathkal. The date and specific venue will be announced here once confirmed.

02How can I register?

Registration details are coming soon. Check this website or our official Instagram for announcements. No ticket prices or booking deadlines have been announced on this site.

03Who can attend?

TEDxNITKSurathkal brings together curious minds from the NITK community and beyond. Eligibility and admission details for the next edition will be shared when registration opens.

04Where can I watch talks from past editions?

Visit our Talk Archives to explore talks from previous TEDxNITKSurathkal editions, or browse Past Editions to discover their themes and speakers.

05How can I partner with the event?

Write to tedx@nitk.edu.in for sponsorship, collaboration and other enquiries. Our organizing team will help you find the right way to get involved.

06Who should I contact about accessibility?

Please email tedx@nitk.edu.in with your access requirements before making travel plans. The team can confirm the arrangements available for the announced venue.
